states.label: 1 MONTH AGO
states.question: How should deterrence, diplomacy, and regional alignments be rebuilt after the US-Israel-Iran war?
states.synthesis: The corpus frames the 2026 US-Israel-Iran war as a structural break: military analysis (cluster-122, cluster-125) treats direct strikes as ending decades of deterrence assumptions, while diplomatic coverage (cluster-124, cluster-140) questions whether any negotiation framework or nuclear containment model survives the escalation. Human-cost and regional-alignment coverage remains thin (cluster-141, cluster-125 only), and the economic dimension is absent from the current cache — a coverage gap worth monitoring next cycle.
